newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Samaranergo pre-tax profit halved in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Samaranergo pre-tax profit halved in 1996.

text.p: NOTES - Full name AO Samaraenergo owns 56 percent of Samarenergo, and foreign investors own about 22 percent (including nominal holdings by CS First Boston, Renaissance Capital and Brunswick, which own 18 percent).

Profit and sales figures preliminary. These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
